- requirement: "The `wait-clarify` and `wait-implement` steps now receive the smoke issue's title as `ISSUE_TITLE` (via `env:`) and pass it to the lookup." (PR description §2)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` lines 614-636 (wait-clarify) and 944-974 (wait-implement)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both steps now declare `ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ steps.create-issue.outputs.title }}` in their `env:` blocks and pass `"${ISSUE_TITLE:-}"` into `find_latest_scoped_run_field`. The most recent autofix commit (996b0ca5) also adds `if [ -z "${ISSUE_TITLE}" ]; then ... status=clarify_failed|implement_failed; exit 1; fi` guards ahead of the helper sourcing, matching the Plan step's existing guard.
- requirement: "A third consecutive failure still reports `lookup_failed`." (PR description §3 for Phase 7)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` lines 3396-3410 (`phase7_list_cancel_runs`)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The helper tries 3 times with 5 s sleeps between attempts. On `_attempt=3` the `if [ "${_attempt}" -lt 3 ]` warning-and-sleep branch is skipped and the function returns 1, after which each caller (`phase7_list_cancel_runs 50`, `1`, `10`) emits `echo "::error::Could not list internal-cancel-on-pr-close runs ..."` and `echo "status=lookup_failed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"` then exits 1. The three failure messages remain in place (verified by `test_phase7_run_listings_all_go_through_the_retry_helper` counting `status=lookup_failed`).
- requirement: "The new helper `find_latest_scoped_run_field` in `scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh` reads further pages until one has a match or comes back short, up to 5 pages. It is used by all three `capture_run_id` definitions and by the Plan wait's `latest_scoped_run_field`." (PR description §1)
  expected_change_site: `scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh` lines 80-140 plus the four call sites in `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `find_latest_scoped_run_field` is defined and bounded by `FIND_LATEST_SCOPED_RUN_MAX_PAGES=5`. The four callers (Clarify capture_run_id at line 650, Plan `latest_scoped_run_field` wrapper at line 770, Implement capture_run_id at line 994) all invoke it. `test_capture_sites_use_the_paged_lookup` asserts `wf.count('find_latest_scoped_run_field "${TEST_REPO}"') == 3` (the Plan step routes through the wrapper so its literal call site is one of the three).
- requirement: "Tests: New `tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py` (11 tests), wired into its own `ci.yml` step." (PR description §Tests)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 927-937 plus the new test file
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: ci.yml has a new step "Release smoke gate run-lookup regression tests" running `python3 tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py`. `test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py` contains 12 `test_*` functions covering first-page match (1 read), the 36374918973 page-2 shape, short-page stop, title filter (including empty-title permissive mode), 5-page cap, read failure, workflow wiring, empty-title guards across all three wait steps, and Phase 7 retry behavior in both 2-failure and 3-failure cases.
- requirement: "Refs #4623" plus the changelog fragment under `changelog.d/release-smoke-run-lookup.md` (`fixed`). (PR description §Changelog / footer)
  expected_change_site: `changelog.d/release-smoke-run-lookup.md`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment file exists, opens with `<!-- changelog: fixed -->`, names the three failed gate runs (36374918973, 36389883126, 36504041362), and follows the §20 voice/structure rules (headline, lead, numbers table, audience closing, contributors section). The PR body uses `Refs #4623` instead of an auto-close keyword, satisfying §19 against `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issues.
